prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-resolution full-body portrait of a clearly adult woman with long voluminous vibrant red hair and a white headband, squatting confidently against a textured gray cinder-block wall. She wears a cozy oversized light-pink hooded sweatshirt and matching jogger sweatpants, with a white long-sleeve shirt visible underneath. She is accessorized with several sparkling silver rings, a thick silver watch on her left wrist, and a prominent shiny silver pendant necklace over the hoodie. She looks directly into the camera with a serious stoic expression while holding a small thin white prop between her fingers near her face. Use soft even overcast daylight, natural highlights on the hair and silver accessories, realistic fabric texture, cool muted urban tones, a 50mm lens, vertical full-body composition, subtle grain, and candid street-fashion realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, unsafe prop, text artifacts
